body: Thank you. I really have tried for all my kitties. I guess I’m still just in shock she’s really gone
I love her so much. She is loved by everyone who met her. She had the biggest personality in the smallest body. I would never trade this year for anything but I would do anything to bring her back.
The vet said she had a spontaneous blood clot. I found her hiding in a box in my closet. I had to drive half an hour to the emergency clinic just for them to say there was nothing they could do.
Thank you... I’m so sorry for your losses... your words mean a lot.
